title: Roma or Napoli top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most Serie A goals for Roma or Napoli since the start of 2000/01 (goals for both clubs added together).

notes.Stephan El Shaarawy: Stephan El Shaarawy is just outside with 52 goals.
notes.Mirko Vucinic: Mirko Vucinic is just outside with 46 goals.
notes.Daniele De Rossi: Daniele De Rossi is just outside with 43 goals.

checks: Goals summed by Transfermarkt player id from every club season page; each club season checked against the table goals for (club_season_checks.csv). Each figure re-added from the player's own Transfermarkt game log, and from the season-by-season club table in the player's English Wikipedia article (Serie A seasons 2000/01 to 2025/26 only).
